target.note: 潮に流された調査機材を探して、浜の拠点へ届けよう。

pines.selection: actual transformed crown angular span within distance / triangle caps
pines.source: Native CC0 wood and leaves retained, with authored supplementary distant branch patches

shrubs.selection: actual transformed crown angular span within distance / triangle caps
shrubs.source: CC0 all-angle branch/needle/leaf models in every ready band

foliage.source: Poly Haven CC0 island_tree_01/02/03 + shrub_02; coastal evergreens, botanical species unverified; authored distance-faded branch atlas supplements distant pine crowns

irradiance.scope: Nine SH coefficients from the actual rendered solar-removed environment cube; diffuse only, specular hemisphere remains approximate

habushiGround.dimensionStatus: photo-informed layout; absolute pavement dimensions unmeasured

spray.approximation: 6m grid / <=0.5s cache / finite-difference FFT compression; wind direction follows local offshore gradient; whitewater bilinear cached height, ground-culling, analytic onshore drift
spray.birthProxyUnits: SWE compression × 0.7s onset / FFT instantaneous dissipation proxy; no residual foam input
